response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS all_album_average FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - b.all_album_average AS above_all_album_average FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > b.all_album_average ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only albums above the all-album average qualify; albums without a calculable rate are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each album's rate as its total bytes divided by its total duration, rather than averaging individual track rates.
alternatives.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Milliseconds <> 0 THEN Bytes END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0 THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS all_album_average FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - b.all_album_average AS above_all_album_average FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > b.all_album_average ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10
